title: Loose ends
text:
A sweep through the realm for anything left half done.

⬆️ Mira's elixirs (Might, Fortitude, Emberlily Tonic, Frostbloom Tonic) are now for alchemists only. Anyone can still have her brew Healing Draughts, and she'll teach you Alchemy on the spot
🔧 Grimmaw the Bonecrawler and Skarn the Ashlord now have proper loot tables, like every other elite
✨ New quests at level 8 (Embers on the Wind, Lilies of the Caldera) and level 16 (Cinderback Hides, Ashbloom for the Wounded), the two levels where quests ran thin
